# News Requirements Quality Checklist: 시장 흐름 뉴스 묶음

**Purpose**: 012 뉴스 기능의 spec·plan·계약이 구현 작업 생성 전에 충분히 완결되고 명확한지 검토한다.
**Created**: 2026-09-10
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the required fields for a displayed digest and each member article exhaustively specified without allowing article body content? [Completeness, Spec FR-001~FR-003, Contract `NewsDigest`]
- [x] CHK002 Are requirements defined for all four consumer-visible states—READY, EMPTY, STALE, and PREPARING—including when each state applies? [Completeness, Spec FR-014·FR-016, Plan "조회와 상태"]
- [x] CHK003 Are current, sector-filtered, and historical query requirements all represented in both the feature requirements and API contract? [Completeness, Spec FR-005~FR-006, Contract `/market-news/digests`]
- [x] CHK004 Are source registration requirements complete for RSS channels, GDELT access, enabled state, language, and publisher identity? [Completeness, Spec FR-009·FR-018, Data Model `NewsPublisher`]
- [x] CHK005 Are collection-state requirements complete for success, no-change, transient failure, rate limiting, retry scheduling, and cursor recovery? [Completeness, Spec FR-013~FR-014, Data Model `NewsCollectionState`]
- [x] CHK006 Are retention requirements complete for the deletion trigger, dependent records, audit result, retry after downtime, and repeat execution? [Completeness, Spec FR-019·SC-007, Plan "보관과 관측성"]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is “신뢰할 수 있는 한 문장 요약” defined precisely enough to make article inclusion or exclusion deterministic? [Clarity, Spec FR-003, Plan "요약·정렬 규칙 v1"]
- [x] CHK008 Is the boundary between permitted metadata and prohibited article body/content unambiguous for every source field, especially RSS description and GDELT payload fields? [Clarity, Spec FR-002~FR-003, Research Decision 2]
- [x] CHK009 Is canonical URL normalization specified precisely enough to produce the same duplicate identity across runs? [Clarity, Spec FR-011, Plan "필터·중복·묶음 규칙 v1"]
- [x] CHK010 Are the token normalization, 48-hour window, shared-topic condition, and Jaccard threshold defined with inclusive/exclusive boundary semantics? [Clarity, Spec FR-011, Plan "필터·중복·묶음 규칙 v1"]
- [x] CHK011 Is “최근성” tied to a specific timestamp and fallback rule when publication time is unknown? [Clarity, Spec FR-004·FR-012, Plan "요약·정렬 규칙 v1"]
- [x] CHK012 Is the 30-minute STALE threshold measured from an explicitly named source or aggregate last-success timestamp? [Clarity, Plan "조회와 상태", Gap]
- [x] CHK013 Is the historical interval defined with clear timezone and inclusive boundary semantics? [Clarity, Spec FR-006, Contract `from`/`to`]
- [x] CHK014 Is the fixed deletion instant on 2026-11-07 defined with an explicit timezone rather than date-only interpretation? [Clarity, Spec FR-019·SC-007, Data Model `NewsRetentionRun`]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK015 Are “three digests” and “do not fill when fewer exist” expressed consistently across scenarios, requirements, success criteria, and `maxItems: 3`? [Consistency, Spec Story 1·FR-001, Contract `digests`]
- [x] CHK016 Is the treatment of unverified publication time consistent between current display, historical exclusion, ranking fallback, and API nullability? [Consistency, Spec FR-006·FR-012, Plan "조회와 상태", Contract `publicationTimeStatus`]
- [x] CHK017 Does permission filtering occur before ranking and publisher counts everywhere it is described, preventing denied or pending sources from leaking indirectly? [Consistency, Spec FR-015~FR-016, Data Model "Query Order"]
- [x] CHK018 Are RSS-primary and GDELT-supplement roles consistent between the spec, research decision, collection plan, and source-type model? [Consistency, Spec FR-009·FR-013, Research Decisions 2~3]
- [x] CHK019 Is the decision not to modify `frontend/`, `worker/`, or `data/` consistent with every planned source-code path and validation instruction? [Consistency, Plan "Project Structure", User scope]
- [x] CHK020 Are the API envelope, camelCase field names, and `/api` proxy semantics consistent with the existing market API conventions documented in the plan? [Consistency, Plan Technical Context, Contract `NewsDigestEnvelope`]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK021 Can the absence of stored or exposed body-like content be measured objectively across the data model and response contract? [Measurability, Spec SC-001, Data Model "공통 원칙"]
- [x] CHK022 Does SC-002 define a target or decision threshold for the measured same-event split rate, rather than only requiring that the rate be recorded? [Measurability, Spec SC-002, Ambiguity]
- [x] CHK023 Can “전망·판정·투자 시사점·수익 원인 단정 표현 0건” be reviewed against a defined prohibited-language policy or fixture corpus? [Measurability, Spec SC-006, Gap]
- [x] CHK024 Are the p95 500ms goal, expected data volume, measurement environment, and sample size specified sufficiently for repeatable evaluation? [Measurability, Plan Technical Context, Gap]
- [x] CHK025 Is “15분 수집 주기 안에 정상 소스 한 회차 완료” measurable when multiple RSS sources and GDELT work are due simultaneously? [Measurability, Plan Technical Context, Gap]
- [x] CHK026 Is the requirement for zero retained news records after cleanup scoped to every dependent table and audit exception? [Measurability, Spec SC-007, Data Model `NewsRetentionRun`]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK027 Are primary flow requirements complete from source discovery through filtering, deduplication, grouping, permission filtering, ranking, and response projection? [Coverage, Spec FR-009~FR-016]
- [x] CHK028 Are alternate flows specified for fewer than three digests, sector with no related news, unknown publication time, and an article lacking safe summary evidence? [Coverage, Spec Story 1~3, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK029 Are exception requirements defined independently for one RSS failure, all RSS failures, GDELT failure, malformed payload, authentication failure, timeout, 429, and 5xx? [Coverage, Spec FR-013~FR-014, Plan "수집과 재시도", Gap]
- [x] CHK030 Are recovery requirements specified for restart after partial batch persistence, stale lease expiry, cursor replay, and a missed retention schedule? [Coverage, Recovery, Plan "수집과 재시도"·"보관과 관측성"]
- [x] CHK031 Are public and internal exposure scenarios distinguished without permitting a client-controlled mode switch? [Coverage, Spec FR-016, Plan "조회와 상태"]
- [x] CHK032 Are historical-news requirements defined when 010/011 integration identifiers are not yet available, without inventing cross-spec IDs? [Dependency, Spec "관련 spec", Contract query model]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK033 Are requirements defined for URL-less items, duplicate GUIDs across feeds, redirect URLs, tracking parameters, and malformed absolute URLs? [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec FR-011~FR-012]
- [x] CHK034 Are requirements defined for future-dated RSS items, invalid dates, timezone-less dates, and GDELT records without publisher publication time? [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec FR-006·FR-012]
- [x] CHK035 Is the behavior defined when an ALLOWED publisher changes to DENIED while its articles are members of mixed-publisher digests? [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec FR-015~FR-016]
- [x] CHK036 Is the behavior defined when permission filtering changes representative title, factual summary, publisher count, or digest ordering? [Coverage, Edge Case, Data Model "Query Order"]
- [x] CHK037 Are grouping requirements defined for transitive similarity where A resembles B and B resembles C but A does not resemble C? [Coverage, Ambiguity, Plan "필터·중복·묶음 규칙 v1"]
- [x] CHK038 Are requirements defined for GDELT API result caps or incomplete time windows so silent coverage claims cannot occur? [Coverage, Edge Case, Research Decision 3]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK039 Are outbound URL allowlisting, redirect handling, response-size limits, XML entity restrictions, and timeout budgets specified to bound untrusted source input? [Security, Gap]
- [x] CHK040 Are secret and sensitive URL redaction requirements complete for logs, stored errors, metrics, and API responses? [Security, Spec FR-018, Plan "보관과 관측성"]
- [x] CHK041 Are concurrency requirements defined for multiple backend instances claiming the same source or retention job? [Reliability, Plan "수집과 재시도"]
- [x] CHK042 Are data-loss and transaction-boundary requirements specified for cursor advancement, article persistence, digest regeneration, and cleanup? [Reliability, Data Model `NewsCollectionState`]
- [x] CHK043 Are observability requirements complete for source freshness, exclusions, duplicates, grouping counts, latency, retry, and deletion outcomes? [Observability, Plan "보관과 관측성"]
- [x] CHK044 Is graceful degradation explicitly required not to mark the entire backend unhealthy when only news is stale or unavailable? [Availability, Spec FR-014, Plan "보관과 관측성"]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [x] CHK045 Is the initial publisher/RSS registry identified as a required team-owned input with an owner and readiness point before implementation or internal validation? [Dependency, Spec Assumptions, Gap]
- [x] CHK046 Is PD-15 clearly treated as a public-release gate but not an internal implementation blocker across spec and plan? [Dependency, Spec PD-15·FR-016, Research "Resolved Unknowns"]
- [x] CHK047 Is the dependency on canonical sector IDs from spec 001 documented strongly enough to prevent locally invented sector identifiers? [Dependency, Spec "관련 spec"·FR-005, Data Model `NewsArticleSector`]
- [x] CHK048 Is the 93-day historical query limit distinguished from GDELT DOC’s source availability and from the product’s metadata retention date? [Assumption, Plan "조회와 상태", Research Decision 3]
- [x] CHK049 Are assumptions behind the initial limits of 20 feeds and 100,000 articles documented as planning bounds rather than validated production capacity? [Assumption, Plan Technical Context]

## Ambiguities and Conflicts

- [x] CHK050 Is it explicit whether RSS `category` values are trusted directly or mapped only through the versioned sector-topic registry? [Ambiguity, Research Decision 2, Data Model `NewsTopic`]
- [x] CHK051 Is “공식 채널” defined with an objective registration and provenance criterion? [Ambiguity, Spec FR-009]
- [x] CHK052 Is the source of a factual summary unambiguous when a digest contains both permitted and non-permitted publishers? [Ambiguity, Spec FR-003·FR-016]
- [x] CHK053 Are stable external ID generation and collision-handling requirements documented for `articleId`, `digestId`, and `ingestRunId`? [Gap, Data Model `NewsArticle`·`NewsDigest`]
- [x] CHK054 Is it explicit whether the retention cleanup also deletes publisher permission records, collection-state records, and rule versions or preserves them as audit metadata? [Ambiguity, Spec FR-019, Data Model `NewsRetentionRun`]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Add review findings and links to the exact spec/plan/contract section beside each item.
- This checklist evaluates requirements writing; it is not an implementation test plan.
